label: Bible Study
prompt: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath _____, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verse: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
note: An invitation to come home — the God who tore is the God who heals.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good _____: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
note: Instead of scolding her for touching Him in the crowd, Jesus gave her a new name — Daughter — and good comfort.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was _____ cubits and a span.
verse: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
note: Goliath stood six cubits and a span tall — over nine feet by the usual reckoning.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But Jonah rose up to _____ unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
verse: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
note: Sent to Nineveh, Jonah booked passage the other way, to Tarshish — paid the fare and everything.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For whom the Lord loveth he _____, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verse: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
note: Hebrews quotes Proverbs 3:12: whom the Lord loveth he 'chasteneth' — discipline as proof you're a true son.
